title: Koala 2026-08-05 — interactive reconstructions
lede: A plush koala captured as 25 RGB-D keyframes — the pipeline's reference-quality result: the fuse AABB (6.00 x 5.75 x 5.00 in) and TRELLIS's independently scaled mesh agree exactly, and the AliceVision scale residual is 6.4 mm. Every panel orbits; Measure On, click two points for real inches.

cards.title: AliceVision
cards.note: The measurable reference for this capture.

cards.title: TRELLIS
cards.scale: metric 152.4 x 146.1 x 127.0 mm (agrees with the fuse)
cards.note: Generated back side is invented but plausible; scale is trustworthy on this capture.

cards.title: 3DGUT — Gaussian splat
cards.note: Photoreal fur. Orbit inside the panel; tape measure not available in splat panels. Panel build: cropped to the subject, 380k splats, opacity floor 0.06 — orbits smoothly.

cards.title: Splatfacto (nerfstudio)
cards.note: The A/B: identical COLMAP input, splatfacto instead of 3DGUT. Note splatfacto spent ~half its gaussians on the carpet where 3DGUT spent 90% on the koala — the crop hides it here, but it is a real trainer difference.
